proposed.explanation: Given your 10+ year horizon and high risk tolerance for long-term wealth building, purchasing 1,212 shares of TMGH at 82.50 EGP per share for a total cost of 99,990.00 EGP fits your available cash of 100,000.00 EGP. TMGH reported 2025 consolidated net profit of 18,201,981,482 LE and consolidated gross profit of 20,855,400,384 LE, up from 14,002,196,445 LE in 2024. Earnings per share grew from 4.38 LE in 2024 to 6.98 LE in 2025, while total consolidated equity reached 157,708,140,765 LE at year-end 2025. The 2024 net profit figure (TMGH-TMGH_FY2025_consolidated_en-p7-56) is unreadable due to an auditor stamp, preventing direct calculation of year-over-year net profit growth, though reported EPS figures confirm solid earnings growth. Note that allocating all cash to one stock creates single-stock concentration risk, and historical financial performance does not guarantee future investment returns.
